response.summary: The plan's facts match the working tree and its three-step pipeline (NFKD + ASCII-ignore + lower, strip non [a-z0-9 whitespace _ -], collapse [whitespace _ -]+ to one hyphen and strip edge hyphens) yields the exact expected string for all five test inputs when traced by hand. No high or medium issues found; two low-severity notes on verification commands.

findings.evidence: The plan uses `git diff -- slugger.py test_slugger.py` to prove test_slugger.py is unchanged. `git diff` without `HEAD` shows only unstaged changes, so a staged edit to the test file would be invisible to that check.
findings.fix: Use `git diff HEAD -- test_slugger.py` (or `git status --short`, which the plan already runs) and confirm test_slugger.py does not appear at all.

findings.evidence: Step 5 collapses separators with `[\s_-]+` but never says to strip leading/trailing hyphens as a distinct operation in the code sketch; the prose does say it. Tracing `'  a  --  b__c  '` gives `'-a-b-c-'` before the strip, so the strip is load-bearing for test_collapses_separators (test_slugger.py:14).
findings.fix: Make the final `.strip('-')` explicit in the implementation step so the builder does not omit it.

coverage: Read slugger.py: confirmed `slugify(text: str) -> str` raises NotImplementedError and the module docstring names the tests as the contract.
Read test_slugger.py: confirmed exactly five tests whose inputs and expected outputs match the plan's acceptance criteria verbatim, including the Unicode escapes for 'Crème Brûlée'.

Hand-traced the plan's pipeline on all five inputs: 'Hello World'→'hello-world'; 'Hello, World! (2026)'→'hello-world-2026'; '  a  --  b__c  '→'-a-b-c-'→strip→'a-b-c'; NFKD decomposes è/û/é into base letter plus combining mark, ASCII-ignore drops the mark, giving 'creme-brulee'; ''→''.
Checked the regex character classes: trailing `-` inside `[...]` is literal, `\s` is safe post-ASCII, `_` is included in both the keep set and the separator set so '__' collapses correctly.
Confirmed standard-library-only: re and unicodedata are stdlib; no third-party imports.
limitations: Could not execute Python or git in this session: the PowerShell PreToolUse hook (gateguard-fact-force) timed out on two attempts because Git Bash is not installed, so the pipeline was verified by manual trace rather than by running `python -m unittest -q`.
